[Thinking]
**Creating a caption**

I need to generate a caption but only have a generic image in mind. I should focus on being concise, capturing the essence without relying on a specific image. This way, I can ensure it's adaptable to different contexts. I want to make sure it resonates with potential viewers, so it has to be engaging yet straightforward. Let’s try to make it impactful in a brief way!
[/Thinking]

Preheat an oiled nonstick pan over medium-high heat to prevent the salmon from sticking.
